  WITH count(n) AS total_nodes

  MATCH (n:Concept)-[r]->(m:Concept)
  WHERE NOT type(r) STARTS WITH 'LINTAS_BUKU'
  WITH total_nodes, count(r) AS total_edges

  RETURN total_nodes, total_edges,
      toFloat(total_edges) / (total_nodes * (total_nodes - 1)) AS graph_density

MATCH (v)

MATCH ()-[e]->()

RETURN
    total_nodes,
    total_edges,
    CASE
        WHEN total_nodes > 1
        THEN toFloat(total_edges) / (total_nodes * (total_nodes - 1))
        ELSE 0
    END AS graph_density

/* 1. Calculate total edges (m) */
MATCH ()-[r]->()
WITH count(r) AS m
WHERE m > 0

/* 2. Calculate the 'Expected' part of the formula (sum of degrees squared) */
MATCH (n)
WHERE n.community IS NOT NULL
WITH m, n.community AS comm, sum(COUNT { (n)--() }) AS communityDegreeSum
WITH m, sum((communityDegreeSum * communityDegreeSum) / (4.0 * m * m)) AS expectedValue

/* 3. Calculate the 'Actual' part (edges inside communities) */
MATCH (n1)-[r]->(n2)
WHERE n1.community = n2.community
WITH m, expectedValue, count(r) AS actualEdges

/* 4. Final Calculation */
RETURN (1.0 * actualEdges / m) - expectedValue AS modularity_score

RETURN modularity

// Step 1: total directed edges between chapter-mapped concepts
  MATCH (c1:Chapter)-[:HAS_SUBTOPIC]->(:Subtopic)-[:HAS_CONCEPT]->(n:Concept)-[r]->(m:Concept)
  MATCH (c2:Chapter)-[:HAS_SUBTOPIC]->(:Subtopic)-[:HAS_CONCEPT]->(m)
  WITH count(r) AS total_m

  // Step 2: k_out and e_cc per source community
  MATCH (c1:Chapter)-[:HAS_SUBTOPIC]->(:Subtopic)-[:HAS_CONCEPT]->(n:Concept)-[r]->(m:Concept)
  MATCH (c2:Chapter)-[:HAS_SUBTOPIC]->(:Subtopic)-[:HAS_CONCEPT]->(m)
  WITH total_m, c1.name AS comm,
       count(r) AS k_out,
       sum(CASE WHEN c1.name = c2.name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS e_cc
  WITH total_m, collect({comm: comm, k_out: k_out, e_cc: e_cc}) AS out_stats

  // Step 3: k_in per target community
  MATCH (c2:Chapter)-[:HAS_SUBTOPIC]->(:Subtopic)-[:HAS_CONCEPT]->(m:Concept)
  MATCH (n:Concept)-[r]->(m)
  MATCH (c1:Chapter)-[:HAS_SUBTOPIC]->(:Subtopic)-[:HAS_CONCEPT]->(n)
  WITH total_m, out_stats, c2.name AS comm, count(r) AS k_in
  WITH total_m, out_stats, collect({comm: comm, k_in: k_in}) AS in_stats

  // Step 4: join by community, compute Q
  UNWIND out_stats AS os
  WITH total_m, os, in_stats
  WITH total_m, os.e_cc AS e_cc, os.k_out AS k_out,
       coalesce([x IN in_stats WHERE x.comm = os.comm | x.k_in][0], 0) AS k_in
  RETURN sum(
    (1.0 * e_cc / total_m) - (1.0 * k_out * k_in / (total_m * total_m))
  ) AS globalModularity

MATCH (n)
WHERE n:Concept OR n:Chapter
WITH n,
     CASE
       WHEN n:Concept THEN n.description
       WHEN n:Chapter THEN n.summary
     END AS desc
WITH count(n) AS total_entities,
     sum(CASE WHEN desc IS NOT NULL AND trim(desc) <> "" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entities_with_description
RETURN total_entities,
       entities_with_description,
       toFloat(entities_with_description) / total_entities AS description_completeness
